headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.64
summary: The Xbox friends list now uses the exact friends endpoint the game itself uses, so friends who rename themselves show up under their new gamertag as soon as the game does.

items.text: Fetch the friends list through the game's own xuid-addressed PeopleHub endpoint instead of the users/me variant that kept serving stale gamertags.
